prerequisites.rationale_text: Must see the system before you can find where to push. Leverage points are defined as places to intervene in a system — without the systems-level view (interconnections, feedback loops, delays), there is no system in which to locate leverage.
prerequisites.source_quote: Systems thinking, the foundation of LPs, is about seeing interrelationships and patterns of change.

curation_notes.summary: Explicit dependency. The LP article directly names systems thinking as the 'foundation' of leverage points.
